data.rationale: The proposal matches the true workflow's procedure (open BOOK > Map search, type origin and pick the airport suggestion, set dates, click Search, view the list of results) and names origin, but it swaps search_type and flexible_dates for trip_type, date_mode and max_price and adds an optional max-price step, so the parameters are only partly right; a browser automation could still be built from it.
